batchDelete.description: Performs batch delete operation on alerts.

delete.description: Marks the specified alert for deletion. An alert that has been marked for deletion is removed from Alert Center after 30 days. Marking an alert for deletion has no effect on an alert which has already been marked for deletion. Attempting to mark a nonexistent alert for deletion results in a `NOT_FOUND` error.

customerId.description: Optional. The unique identifier of the Google Workspace account of the customer the alert is associated with. [Find your customer ID](https://support.google.com/cloudidentity/answer/10070793).

alertId.description: Required. The identifier of the alert to undelete.

undelete.description: Restores, or "undeletes", an alert that was marked for deletion within the past 30 days. Attempting to undelete an alert which was marked for deletion over 30 days ago (which has been removed from the Alert Center database) or a nonexistent alert returns a `NOT_FOUND` error. Attempting to undelete an alert which has not been marked for deletion has no effect.

filter.description: Optional. A query string for filtering alert results. pageToken.description: Optional. A token identifying a page of results the server should return. If empty, a new iteration is started. To continue an iteration, pass in the value from the previous ListAlertsResponse's next_page_token field.

[Find your customer ID](https://support.google.com/cloudidentity/answer/10070793).

enumDescriptions: AbuseDetected alert variation type unspecified. No alert should be unspecified.
Variation displayed for Drive abusive content alerts.
Variation displayed for Limited Disable alerts, when a Google service is disabled for a user, totally or partially, due to the user's abusive behavior.
variationType.description: Variation of AbuseDetected alerts. The variation_type determines the texts displayed the alert details. This differs from sub_alert_id because each sub alert can have multiple variation_types, representing different stages of the alert.

evidenceLockerFilePath.description: Google Cloud Storage location of the content that violated the rule. This field has format: "/"

intValue.description: Value if the type is integer

timestampValue.description: Value is the type is a timestamp

stringValue.description: Value if the type is string

boolValue.description: Value if the type is boolean

ApnsCertificateExpirationInfo.description: The explanation message associated with "APNS certificate is expiring soon" and "APNS certificate has expired" alerts.

expirationTime.description: The expiration date of the APNS certificate.

appleId.description: The Apple ID used to create the certificate. It may be blank if admins didn't enter it.

ListAlertFeedbackResponse.description: Response message for an alert feedback listing request.

feedback.description: The list of alert feedback. Feedback entries for each alert are ordered by creation time descending.

ActivityRule.description: Alerts from Google Workspace Security Center rules service configured by an admin.

query.description: Query that is used to get the data from the associated source.

updateTime.description: The timestamp of the last update to the rule.

triggerSource.description: The trigger sources for this rule. * GMAIL_EVENTS * DEVICE_EVENTS * USER_EVENTS

supersededAlerts.description: List of alert IDs superseded by this alert. It is used to indicate that this alert is essentially extension of superseded alerts and we found the relationship after creating these alerts.

windowSize.description: Rule window size. Possible values are 1 hour or 24 hours.

supersedingAlert.description: Alert ID superseding this alert. It is used to indicate that superseding alert is essentially extension of this alert and we found the relationship after creating both alerts.

actionNames.description: List of action names associated with the rule threshold.

GmailMessageInfo.description: Details of a message in phishing spike alert.

date.description: The date of the event related to this email.

md5HashMessageBody.description: The hash of the message body text.

sentTime.description: The sent time of the email.

md5HashSubject.description: The MD5 Hash of email's subject (only available for reported emails).

attachmentsSha256Hash.description: The `SHA256` hash of email's attachment and all MIME parts.

subjectText.description: The email subject text (only available for reported emails).

messageBodySnippet.description: The snippet of the message body text (only available for reported emails).

email.description: The email of the user this incident was created for.

StateSponsoredAttack.description: A state-sponsored attack alert. Derived from audit logs.

AlertFeedback.description: A customer feedback about an alert.

feedbackId.description: Output only. The unique identifier for the feedback.

customerId.description: Output only. The unique identifier of the Google Workspace account of the customer.

enumDescriptions: The feedback type is not specified.

The alert report is very useful.
type.description: Required. The type of the feedback.

email.description: Output only. The email of the user that provided the feedback.

createTime.description: Output only. The time this feedback was created.

Csv.description: A representation of a CSV file attachment, as a list of column headers and a list of data rows.

dataRows.description: The list of data rows in a CSV file, as string arrays rather than as a single comma-separated string.

headers.description: The list of headers for data columns in a CSV file.

actorEmail.description: Email of person who performed the action

superAdminPasswordResetEvent.description: Event occurred when password was reset for super admin in customer's account

ssoProfileCreatedEvent.description: Event occurred when SSO Profile created in customer's account

eventTime.description: The time at which event occurred

ssoProfileDeletedEvent.description: Event occurred when SSO Profile deleted in customer's account

primaryAdminChangedEvent.description: Event occurred when primary admin changed in customer's account
